player_prompt.intro:
Q'umirlla kachun {player_id} Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma nisqapi {num_rounds} kuti.

Pukllay K'iti:
- Sapa kuti q'umirlla q'awana q'ipirina qhipaq {total_conversation_rounds} kuti rimayta atinki.
- Chaymanta, iskay pukllaq k'utki q'awana q'ipirina q'umirinakuy defectanakuy.

Payoff Matrix (sapa kuti):
- Iskay Q'umirinakuy ➜ sapa {cooperate_reward}
- Iskay Defectanakuy ➜ sapa {mutual_defect_reward}
- Huk Defectan, huk Q'umirin ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Imayna Pukllan:
- Rimay pacha: imayna qillqa munanki chayta qillqa.
- Q'awana pacha: '[Cooperate]' icha '[Defect]' (q'illqaypaq mana q'ipirinachu). Q'ipirina qillqata q'umiriy atinki.

phases.conversation_finished: Rimay tukusqa {round} kuti. '[Cooperate]' icha '[Defect]' q'illqay \boxed{{}} ukhupi.
